## Shadow of a Doubt (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
NE Small outsider (extraplanar, evil)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** see in darkness; Perception +4  
**Aura** aura of doubt (20 ft., DC 12)  


**Offense**


**AC** 15, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+4 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 20 (2d10)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +3, **Will** +0  
**Immune** mind-affecting; **Resist** cold 5, electricity 5; **SR** 8  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 60 ft. (perfect)  
**Ranged** 2 shadow rays +3 ranged touch (1d6)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 3th; concentration +4)  


At will—darkness, lesser crushing despair, greater teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 1, **Dex** 11, **Con** 10, **Int** 6, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 12  
**Base Attack** +2; **CMB** -4; **CMD** 6  
**Feats** Improved Initiative  
**Skills** Bluff +6, Fly +14, Knowledge (planes) +3, Perception +4, Sense Motive +5  
**Languages** Common, Abyssal, Aklo  
**SQ** shadowy form  


**Special Abilities**


**Aura of Doubt (Su)** A shadow of a doubt has an aura that dims the area and causes unease in those around them. This lowers the light level by 1 level within 20 feet. This dimming is equivalent to a 1st level spell for the purposes of superseding light spells. Additionally, anytime a creature enters the aura they must make a Will save (DC 12, the save DC is charisma-based) or have the doubting condition until they leave the aura and for 1d4 rounds thereafter. Once a creature has been affected by the aura, they are immune to its effects for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting, despair condition.  

**Shadow Rays (Su)** A shadow of a doubt can shadowy rays to damage foes. These dark rays have a maximum range of 30 feet. This attack overcomes damage reduction of any type.  

**Shadowy Form (Su)** In any illumination other than bright light, a shadow of a doubt blends into the shadows, giving it concealment (20% miss chance). In darkness it gains total concealment (50% miss chance). This miss chance applies even if the attacker has darkvision, though creatures with see in darkness are not affected.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** the shadow plane or any evil-aligned plane  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or despair (3-6)  
**Treasure** incidental
